svg.title: Party tray system — bazaar
svg.text: Catering · board lid for half-size foil pans with a colour-coded 6 × 4 in label per menu zone
1 · PRINTED BOARD LID — half-size foil pan · 314 × 254 mm
Party at yours? We’ll bring the biryani.
LIFT FROM THE BASE · KEEP LEVEL
2 · ZONE LABELS — 6 × 4 in, colour-coded by menu district
Lid: printed outside face only; foil laminate faces the food.
Label goes on the lid, never on food contact surfaces.
Heat-and-serve copy is generic by design:
Curry District · Drinks & Catering packaging concepts · flat artwork (vector, fonts embedded)
Independent design concept prepared as a proposal — not official Curry District material.
